Container.Name: shrinkyourshit
Container.Overview: ShrinkYourShit watches folders of media files and makes the ones that need it take much less space, then keeps a record of what it did. Point it at a folder, pick how much space you want to save, and it works through the folder in the background — files that are already small in the right way are left alone. Runs on the server itself, and other machines on the network can help it once you add them from the Nodes page.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The web UI and API. Open http://[IP]:[PORT:8765] after install.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Settings and database. Must be writable.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your media folder. Must be writable: the smaller files replace the originals in place.

Config.Name: Scratch
Config.Description: Temp space used while a file is being worked on. Keep it on the array or pool.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Unraid user id that owns the folders (99 is nobody, the Unraid default). Check with: id -u

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Unraid group id that owns the folders (100 is users, the Unraid default). Check with: id -g
